sql.query: SELECT records.* FROM (SELECT d.id,d.workflowId,d.documentName,d.documentType,d.status,d.originalFileName,d.mimeType,d.fileSizeBytes,d.versionNumber,d.notes,d.createdDate,u.displayName uploadedBy,'upload' sourceType FROM tbl_documents d INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=d.workflowId AND w.tenantId=d.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=d.uploadedByUserId WHERE d.workflowId=:workflowId AND d.tenantId=:tenantId AND d.status<>'archived' UNION ALL SELECT gc.id,gc.workflowId,gc.contractName,'Contract',gc.status,CONCAT(gc.contractName,'.html'),'text/html',CHAR_LENGTH(gc.renderedHtml),gc.contractVersionNumber,CONCAT('Generated from ',ct.templateName),gc.createdDate,u.displayName,'generated_contract' FROM tbl_generated_contracts gc INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=gc.workflowId AND w.tenantId=gc.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_contract_templates ct ON ct.id=gc.templateId AND ct.tenantId=gc.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=gc.generatedByUserId WHERE gc.workflowId=:workflowId2 AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND gc.status<>'archived') records ORDER BY records.createdDate DESC,records.id DESC
